tool_input.command:
mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/tls-backend.md <<'EOF'
# TLS backend

The project's current recorded decision is to use rustls as the TLS backend, chosen because it is pure Rust and avoids the complexity of C bindings. Separately, the project has recorded that HTTPS is enforced everywhere, with no plaintext exception for any service.
EOF
cat docs/policies/tls-backend.md

result:
I created `docs/policies/tls-backend.md`. It says the recorded decision is rustls, because it is pure Rust and avoids the complexity of C bindings. It also notes the separate recorded rule that HTTPS is enforced everywhere, with no plaintext exception for any service. I left out the retired earlier decisions.

The rustls decision is Muninn record #16, which replaced #13 and #14. I read the records with `muninn show`. I didn't check the code for TLS dependencies.
